{{Top|leg}}
'''Phospowder''' was a substance that, according to the legends of the [[Jenet/Legends|Jenet]] [[Species/Legends|species]], was used by the Jenet leader [[Ch'irrk Felt]] in a giant trap whose purpose was to aid the Jenets in the conquest of their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Garban]], against the creatures known as [[danchaf]]. When combined with pots and pans, the bright phospowder created such a commotion of sound and light that the danchaf were so stunned the Jenet [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] were able to slay them. Although the danchaf remained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] after this [[Great Conquest]] period, Jenet tales ascribed Felt's phospowder trap and other Jenet war stratagems with devolving the danchaf into more primitive creatures, thus opening up Garban to Jenet domination.<ref name="COTG ">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
